Vivaha Bhojanambu is now open in Marathahalli, bringing bold Andhra/Telugu flavours, full bhojanam vibes, crispy starters, loaded meals, seafood specials and desserts that feel made for a family feast.

Come hungry, because this place is not doing small portions.
